name: GitHub Copilot SDK — direct to APIM
summary: Copilot SDK BYOK provider pointed straight at the APIM AI Gateway, bypassing Foundry entirely.
description: APIM already exposes an OpenAI-compatible surface, so `base_url = "https://<apim>.azure-api.net/openai/v1/"` + APIM subscription key (or a static JWT via `bearerToken`) lets the Copilot SDK talk to your AI Gateway without any Foundry involvement. In this topology there is no `{conn}/{model}` BYOM prefix — the model string is just the APIM deployment name, because you're already at the gateway.
notes:
APIM in this environment has `publicNetworkAccess=disabled` — direct calls from GitHub-hosted runners return `403 public network access ... is disabled`. This card is only meaningfully verifiable from a self-hosted runner inside the APIM VNet (or a caller with private-endpoint reachability). Auth uses `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` or a bearer token, and Entra-fronted gateways should use `bearer_token_provider` so tokens refresh per request.

No BYOM prefix is expected in this topology because APIM is already the gateway; `wire_model` is the APIM deployment name. See `test.py` for the Copilot session against `APIM_BASE_URL` using `APIM_DEPLOYMENT` / `CHAT_MODEL`. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/api-management/genai-gateway-capabilities; sample: https://github.com/github/copilot-sdk/blob/main/docs/auth/byok.md.
